items.title: BINI Fan-Made Website
items.summary: A fan-made website concept for the eight-member Filipino pop group BINI, built with Next.js and Sanity CMS.
items.context: Fan sites need a clear way to present group information and discography while keeping content maintainable.
items.approach: Built a responsive web experience and connected content to Sanity CMS. A custom Spotify pipeline script generates a bini_discography.json data file.
items.disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made project; not affiliated with BINI or its management.

items.title: Nothing-Inspired Headless Shopify Concept
items.summary: An experimental headless storefront concept using Next.js Commerce and the Shopify Storefront API.
items.context: Explore how a branded storefront can combine a custom frontend with Shopify product and variant data.
items.approach: Implemented dynamic variant orchestration, an automated logic layer, and a sticky add-to-cart interaction.
items.disclaimer: Concept project. Checkout currently redirects to Shopify; do not present it as a fully headless checkout.

items.title: Nova Echo Website Redesign Concept
items.summary: A website redesign concept focused on visual consistency, navigation behavior, and reducing interface clutter.
items.context: The review identified inconsistent CTA gradients and colors, a non-sticky header, and an overloaded card layout.
items.approach: Used the audit findings as a basis for a clearer visual system and more consistent page structure.
items.disclaimer: Concept redesign; do not claim client engagement or measured conversion results.

items.title: University Event Management System
items.summary: An event-management system worked on during a web development internship.
items.context: Event workflows require eligibility checks, attendance tracking, and role-aware access.
items.approach: Worked with a Laravel, Filament PHP, and MySQL system that included eligibility validation, QR-based check-ins, and role-based access control.
items.disclaimer: Internship work. Keep unpublished until scope, screenshots, and permission to display are confirmed.

items.title: AI-Integrated Scam Detection Platform
items.summary: An academic capstone project exploring scam detection with external analysis APIs.
items.context: Users need help assessing suspicious messages, links, or signals before acting on them.
items.approach: The project integrated Gemini API and VirusTotal API as part of an AI-assisted scam detection workflow.
items.disclaimer: Academic project. Do not claim production readiness, detection accuracy, or security guarantees without validated evidence.

items.title: Selected Graphic Design Work
items.summary: A curated selection of graphic design work across social content, covers, flyers, infographics, and illustration.
items.context: Different communication needs call for clear hierarchy, visual consistency, and format-aware design.
items.approach: Select representative work, add brief context for each piece, and show the range without implying unmeasured results.
items.disclaimer: Add only work you have permission to display; identify personal or speculative pieces accurately.

items.title: Email & Task Management Workflow
items.summary: Planned demonstration project showing how an inbox and task list can be triaged using a clear priority system.
items.context: When multiple requests arrive at once, teams need a repeatable way to distinguish urgent work, waiting items, and routine follow-ups.
items.approach: Build a fictional sample inbox, define a priority matrix, organize tasks by urgency and impact, and document the rules used. Use synthetic data only.
items.altText: Email and task management workflow demo
items.disclaimer: Planned demo, not client work. Create and review artifacts before publishing.

items.title: Presentation Deck: From Notes to Clear Slides
items.summary: Planned demo transforming a fictional brief or supplied notes into a concise, well-structured presentation.
items.context: Dense information is difficult to scan when slides lack hierarchy and a clear narrative.
items.approach: Create a fictional brief, outline the story, design a consistent slide system, and show the before/after information structure.
items.disclaimer: Planned demo, not client work. Build the deck and add screenshots before publishing.
